id: title:Gilbert09:retry connection resets during response streaming

review.posthog_relevance: Adds retry handling for LinkedIn Ads ingestion when the HTTP response stream is broken, preserving ingestion continuity against transient failures.
review.reason: Adds ChunkedEncodingError to the retry exception tuple and documentation, with a corresponding regression test. This is a substantive, bounded reliability improvement for the LinkedIn Ads ingestion path, not a narrow maintenance change.
review.uncertainty: The benefit is limited to transient stream breaks; no evidence of actual incidents or broader systemic impact.

observations.limitations: Only supplied hunk IDs are used; no score assigned. No adoption, incident, or benefit is inferred. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds requests.exceptions.ChunkedEncodingError to the retry exception tuple in _get_fields_for_resource, alongside existing LinkedinAdsRetryableError, requests.ConnectionError, and requests.Timeout.
observations.posthog_connection: Retries LinkedIn Ads ingestion requests when the underlying HTTP response stream is broken, rather than failing immediately. This could preserve ingestion continuity when LinkedIn returns a partial or reset response body, potentially avoiding transient ingestion failures.

observations.behavior: Adds ChunkedEncodingError to the docstring explaining why it is not a ConnectionError subclass and therefore requires its own entry in the retry tuple.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the implementation rationale for including ChunkedEncodingError in the retry set, supporting maintainability and future debugging of this ingestion path.

observations.behavior: Adds a pytest test case that asserts ChunkedEncodingError is treated as a retryable error with a score of 3, alongside existing connection and timeout tests.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds regression test coverage for the new ChunkedEncodingError handling, supporting the reliability and correctness of the retry behavior.
